meta.title: API Keys
meta.description: A credential proxy for outbound API calls: keeps keys for GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, npm, Docker Hub, Hugging Face and your own platforms — in the DSH credential store, or in an optional AES-256-GCM vault unlocked by a master password — and gives the model apikey_call, apikey_platforms, apikey_key and apikey_upload so it can call their APIs as you without holding the key. Includes response redaction, a hash-chained audit log, per-platform credential failover and an out-of-band CLI.
